meta.title: Implement local storage persistence
meta.body_summary: Cursors agent added localStorage persistence with Zod schemas for AI config and user input, debounced input persistence, and useMemo to optimize performance, then author refactored and merged instantly.

perf_labels.notes: Cursors agent added localStorage persistence with debounce and memoization; merged instantly by author without review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1197 changed lines across 16 files, this is a medium-sized feature addition by absolute volume. It includes new persistence utility, debounced hook, and refactors, merged instantly without formal review, indicating low friction but also lack of collaborative scrutiny.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews, comments, or inline discussions captured in dataset.
review_details.performance_claim: Implement localStorage persistence with debounced writes (300ms) and memoization to optimize performance and prevent unnecessary renders.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent handled frontend state persistence, debounce, memoization, and Zod validation in a single large PR; merged immediately by the author without external review, indicating a self-merge workflow with no quality gate.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmarks, before/after measurements, or specific reproduction steps provided in PR body; only narrative description of debounce and memoization.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; PR merged immediately after creation.

core_change_summary.description: Added src/lib/persistence.ts with Zod schemas for localStorage AI config and user input; updated model-store.ts and chat-store.ts to use this utility; added use-debounced-persist.ts hook (later removed) and debounced input persistence in chat-store; applied useMemo in chat.tsx; adjusted imports for enabledTools from modelStore; second commit cleaned up code, made models non-dynamic, and refactored persistence and components.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Many convex backend files changed in second commit to remove dynamic model loading, likely unrelated to frontend performance.
change_trajectory: First commit (Cursor agent): create persistence.ts, use-debounced-persist.ts, update stores and components with persistence and debounce.
Second commit (f1shy-dev): remove use-debounced-persist.ts, refactor persistence.ts heavily, make models non-dynamic, cleanup components.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor agent made initial commit with persistence feature.
Author (f1shy-dev) immediately followed up with a larger refactor/cleanup commit.
PR merged by author ~7 seconds after creation with no external review.
